# BuildersHaus

BuildersHaus helps property owners discuss building, renovation and repair projects and connect with industry contacts.

Project enquiries: build@buildershaus.com.

Business registration through IAM is $10 USD per year on one industry hub. City-page partnerships require a fit review with scope, content expectations and separate pricing agreed before activation.

BuildersHaus is part of the IAM network. https://www.industryarmymarketing.com/

## Registered BuildersHaus businesses
- Rambo Wall & Ceiling: https://www.buildershaus.com/businesses/rambo-wall-ceiling — Walls, ceilings & steel stud framing; direct enquiries rambowallceiling@gmail.com
- BeeWarm: https://www.buildershaus.com/businesses/beewarm — Fireplaces, heating & gas fitting; direct enquiries bee@beewarm.ca
- LS Fencing & Metal Work: https://www.buildershaus.com/businesses/ls-fencing-metal-work — Fencing, gates & metal work; direct enquiries Lsfencingandmetalwork@gmail.com
